column1: Content notes (not tag changes, for the content team)

column3: Neighborhood guides are one of the best pages for local and AI search ("hotels near Gaslamp Quarter", "things to do near Little Italy"). Worth giving this page real content.
"dining 1", "dining 2", "dining 3" are placeholder names, and most text on the page is lorem ipsum.
The arts & culture slider shows the Midway Museum plus four hotel offers. It should show attractions only.
The six FAQ questions are the same room questions ("this room") on every page. Each page needs its own questions about its topic. These are the answers AI tools look for.
